description: This file contains a PHP class named 'Weight' that is part of the OpenCart admin shipping extension. It defines a controller for managing shipping weight settings within the OpenCart e-commerce platform, including methods for displaying, saving, and configuring shipping weight options.

classes.name: Weight
classes.description: Controller class for handling the shipping weight configuration in the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the shipping weight configuration page, loading required language, models, and setting data.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the shipping weight configuration via POST request, including permission checks and validation.
